title: Reports Allege FIFA Knew Congo Fielded Ineligible Player vs. Nigeria in WC Qualifier
detail: Reports by The New York Times, Le Monde and The Athletic say FIFA lawyers found in March 2026 that DR Congo goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi, who had played for France's youth teams, was ineligible after not completing the paperwork to switch allegiance, yet he kept playing in the World Cup qualifiers and tournament. Nigeria's complaint over Congo's qualifier win was reportedly dismissed on a technicality; FIFA said its committees are autonomous and that Infantino had no role. Congo's federation president Véron Mosengo-Omba is reported to be a close friend of Infantino. By Oct 7, Nigeria was reported to be considering legal action.

media.caption: Reports: FIFA knew Congo goalkeeper was ineligible
